cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: No Tie Stands
cards.instruction: Turn every even outcome into a formal rematch with a new rule and a consequence for losing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. We split the bill exactly. Now toss for who apologises to the waiter.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Otherwise this dinner ends without a distinction.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then least enthusiastic enjoyment pays the tip. Rate yours carefully.

mechanism: A refuses to let an even result close the encounter and uses assumed rulemaking authority to impose a defined tiebreak with a new condition and loser consequence.
confusable: Generic competitiveness is confusable: an actual even outcome must trigger a formal rematch, with both its changed rule and cost of losing made clear.
comparison: Cake tie changes testing format when B refuses more baking; evenly split dinner becomes a new contest over enjoyment with tip as consequence.
seedUse: Both exact cards and all four seeds read. Preserve initial equality and B objection, but keep later rematch terms and losing consequence intelligible rather than changing to an undefined contest.
